'''Zaa Vashee''' was the [[Togruta/Legends|Togruta]] [[Prince/Legends|princess]] of [[Shili/Legends|Shili]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].

The princess's identity was used by [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] [[Ahsoka Tano/Legends|Ahsoka Tano]] during a mission on [[Zygerria/Legends|Zygerria]].
